results.title: LeadDelta : LinkedIn CRM/Inbox built for modern teams powered by AI | Product Hunt
results.content:
Report

•1 review

LeadDelta is one of the tools that changed my life. It helps me communicate with potential leads and prepare a release of my new tool. There are two features I cannot live without: Tag (I'm using it to group my connections around topics) and Notes (given that I'm talking to many people daily, it helps me remember the most crucial elements of previous conversations). In the end, LeadDelta has the best customer success team I have ever faced. They are agile (working 24/7 for real), and they do not stop until they help you. They are so good; that I'm implementing some tactics into my business.

Report

LeadDelta

•1 review [...] Launched on November 15th, 2022

View all LeadDelta launches

4.8

Based on 24 reviews

Review LeadDelta ?

Reviewers mostly praise LeadDelta for making LinkedIn contact management simpler and less messy. They repeatedly highlight the fast, spreadsheet-like dashboard, strong tagging, notes, filters, and built-in inbox as useful for organizing conversations, tracking follow-ups, and handling outreach without jumping between tools. Several say it is intuitive from the start and helps them stay on top of large networks. The clear exception is one detailed complaint about imported contacts creating duplicates, no true deletion option, distorted dashboard counts, and a poor refund and support experience.

Adding new people and growing my network was the biggest challenge I faced, and I'm grateful to find Lead Delta early on and start managing my connections. Lead Delta has helped me cut through the chaos in my mind and network and work more systematically not to lose any information. One of my favorite features would be notes and tags, as I can access information quickly and have a continuous workflow. The development team is killing it with new features coming in constantly.
